_note: A uniform allowance, exempt to the extent actually spent on the uniform (D-101; rulebook SAL-ALW-DUTY-001, H-9). TY 2026-27: Income-tax Act, 2025 Sch. III Table Sl. 12, "to the extent to which such expenses are actually incurred for that purpose"; Income-tax Rules, 2026 r.280(1)(g): "any allowance granted to meet the expenditure incurred on the purchase or maintenance of uniform for wear during the performance of the duties of an office or employment of profit"; not in r.280(3)'s list, so not in the new regime (s.202(2)(a)(ii)). TY 2025-26: 1961 s.10(14)(i) exempts allowances prescribed "to the extent to which such expenses are actually incurred"; Income-tax Rules, 1962 r.2BB(1)(f), the same words; not in r.2BB(3)'s list (G.S.R. 452(E)), so not for an assessee taxed under s.115BAC(1A).
